messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT 2081234567 — GPU node RDX-GPU-12 reporting repeated CUDA_ILLEGAL_MEMORY_ACCESS errors + OOM kills across several inference containers. Auto-eviction triggered. Severity: candidate sev2. Notifying oncall.

Alice Chen: Acknowledged, I'm oncall. Which clusters/racks affected?

Marco Ruiz: Seeing repeated Xid entries in dmesg (GPU driver). Pasting recent kernel lines:
```
[ 12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, PID=4213, GPU=0, Channel ID=402
[ 12345.679002] gpu0: CUDA illegal memory access at 0x7f8b9c000000
[ 12345.679100] oom-kill: containerd-shim invoked oom-killer: Killed process 4213 (runtime) total-vm: 1023456kB
```

Marco Ruiz: Also seeing kernel oops lines mentioning "misaligned address" in the GPU driver stack — could be a race. Node kernel: 6.4.0-rt; nvidia driver 535.54.

Priya Singh: We rolled out the runtime image rwinf/runtime:2026-03-11-optimized-batching across this rack yesterday. It included a small change in the GPU memory allocator (async page pinning). Might be related.

Liam O'Connor: Network-wise the node had one brief interface flap 4m ago but looks unrelated. I'm more worried about page migration and host compaction interactions. We saw similar symptoms in staging when we enabled async pinning + hugepage compaction.

Alice Chen: Immediate mitigation: cordon RDX-GPU-12 and drain pods that are failing. Shift traffic off that node and activate model fallback to smaller model-variant in the routing policy. Can someone run the drain and confirm?

deploy-bot: @channel Traffic policy updated: 100% traffic shifted off node RDX-GPU-12 -> fallback pool rdx-fallback-1. Canary at 10% on healthy nodes.

Liam O'Connor: Cordon done. Starting evacuation: `kubectl drain rdx-gpu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30`

Marco Ruiz: While we evacuate, please collect the following from the affected node before restart: `dmesg -T | tail -n 200`, `/var/log/nvidia-installer.log`, `journalctl -u kubelet -n 500`, `nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY,ERROR` and `cat /proc/driver/nvidia/params` if present. Also capture a full `gcore` of container PID 4213 if it's still alive for offline analysis.

Priya Singh: I'm going to run the in-house reproducer against a pinned test instance. Quick note: add `CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1` when running the reproducer to get a deterministic stack trace.

Alice Chen: Customer impact: Cloud metrics show 2.3% 5xx rate increase in the last 10m for serving endpoints, latency tail increased on a couple of routes. CS: notify the three dedicated customers on the affected capacity pool. @Nina Patel can you handle comms?

Nina Patel: On it. Drafting a short status: we detected GPU runtime crashes on one node, traffic was immediately shifted, mitigation in place, we're investigating root cause. Will flag impacted customers and estimated ETA after triage results.

Marco Ruiz: Posting an example of the GPU error block for the infra ticket:
```
Mar 15 12:04:23 rdx-gpu-12 kernel: NVRM: GPU at PCI:0000:65:00: GPU-abcdef123456
Mar 15 12:04:23 rdx-gpu-12 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79: GPU has fallen off the bus.
Mar 15 12:04:24 rdx-gpu-12 runtime[4213]: cudaErrorIllegalAddress: an illegal memory access was encountered
```

Liam O'Connor: Hypothesis: asynchronous page pinning + host page compaction race leading to misaligned GPU page tables -> illegal access when kernel and driver disagree on mapping. Short-term fix: disable async pinning in runtime on rollout and rollback to previous runtime image for affected nodes. Long-term: add fence to allocator and validate new driver path.

Priya Singh: I can trigger rollback for the runtime on the affected DS (deployment set). Suggest revert to rwinf/runtime:2026-03-08-stable. Do we want to do that cluster-wide or just the rack?

Alice Chen: Rollback only on the affected rack first. We need to confirm reproducer results and driver logs before a global rollback. Priya, proceed with rack rollback and post the rollout plan.

Priya Singh: Starting rollback on rdx-rack-7 (contains RDX-GPU-12). Command: `kubectl set image ds/runtime rwinf/runtime:2026-03-08-stable -n inference --namespace=inference` Rolling with maxUnavailable=1.

deploy-bot: Deploy event: rwinf/runtime rollback started for rdx-rack-7 by Priya Singh.

Marco Ruiz: Collected `dmesg` snippet and uploaded to the incident ticket (link). Also grabbed `nvidia-smi -q -d ERROR` — it shows ECC errors increasing on GPU0; drivers report pending page faults.

Liam O'Connor: If rollback doesn't stop the errors, plan B: reboot the node with driver downgrade to 525.x to ensure kernel driver ABI alignment. I'll prep the image.

Alice Chen: Monitoring: 5xx rate climbed to peak 2.8% at 12:08, now back to 0.6% after traffic shift. No large-scale customer outages. Marking mitigation in place.

Nina Patel: Elevating to Sev2 because of potential platform-wide regression. Postmortem owner: Marco Ruiz. Follow-ups: reproduce in staging, add allocator fences, add stricter preflight for runtime driver/allocator combos, notify customers previously affected.

Marco Ruiz: Taking postmortem ownership. Immediate next steps captured in the ticket. Will request kernel oops trace and full GPU core dump from infra.

oncall-bot: ACTIONS TAKEN: node cordoned/drained, traffic rerouted to fallback pool, runtime rollback initiated for rack, monitoring elevated. Please update incident ticket when rollback completes.

Alice Chen: Thanks all. If the rollback stabilizes the rack, we'll uncordon and progressively bring nodes back into rotation. Until then keep the channel updated with any new crashes.

deploy-bot: Deploy event: rwinf/runtime rollback completed for rdx-rack-7.

Marco Ruiz: After rollback: no new Xid entries for 12m. GPU counters stable. Keeping under observation for 30m then will run scheduled regression test.

Nina Patel: Notifying CS teams and creating customer-impact digest. Postmortem will be shared in 48h.

oncall-bot: Incident 2081234567 — mitigation in place, monitoring. Will watch for recurrence and escalate if needed.
